t: Arrest Of Seven Koreans In French Town

Date. 24/6/22

Hongkow. Station.
14th, May. 1922.

REPORT ON Arrest of Seven Koreans in French Town.

Made by D.S.Conduit. Forwarded by

Sir,

I beg to report that at 5.30am, this day,
D.C.Okajima and I accompanied Japanese Magistrate Kinoshita
and several Constables from the Japanese Consulate to Avenue
Joffre Police Station we were met there by Detective Sidiane
and several Chinese Detectives.

Three houses were visited and 7 Koreans were
brought to the Joffre Station, the following is a list of
the Koreans names,

Nyeu Sz Shung (元世勳), Nyeu Kung Zeu (南公蒼), Tsung
You Ling (鄭有隣), Lee Chi Fok (李基福) arrested
at No.8 Pau Kong Li, (宝康里) Avenue Joffre, Ling Hwo
(林虎), and a man named Kim arrested in an alleyway
near the first address, and Ching Kwe (金龜) arrested at
No. 5 Kung Sung Nyou Li (公生南里).

Magistrate Kinoshita said he had a warrant for
the last named for committing three murders in Shanghai.

The French Police arranged with the Magistrate
that they would hold all the Koreans in custody, until an appli-
cation had been made at the French Consulate to have them hand-
ed over.

I have been informed by Okijina that the Japan-
ese Consulate Authorities had made an application for 5 of the
7 Koreans. When the application was sent over, the Japanese
were informed that the Police had released all the Koreans.
I believe that the Japanese Consul General is taken the matter
up with the French Authorities.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
R. Conduit.
D.S.
D.C.I.

X. O. REC.
编号 4550
日期：1922年6月24日

虹口巡捕房。
1922年5月14日。

关于在法租界逮捕七名朝鲜人的报告。

由 D.S. Conduit 撰写。呈报人

先生，

谨此报告，今日凌晨5时30分，
警探 Okajima 与我陪同日本领事馆裁判官木下（Kinoshita）
及数名来自日本领事馆的巡捕前往霞飞路巡捕房，我们在那里
遇到了侦探 Sidiane 和几名华籍侦探。

我们搜查了三处住所，并将7名朝鲜人带至
霞飞路巡捕房，以下是这些朝鲜人的姓名清单，

元世勳（Nyeu Sz Shung）、南公蒼（Nyeu Kung Zeu）、鄭有隣（Tsung
You Ling）、李基福（Lee Chi Fok），上述四人被捕于
霞飞路宝康里8号，林虎（Ling Hwo）
以及一名姓金（Kim）的男子在第一处地址附近的一条弄堂内被捕，
金龜（Ching Kwe）被捕于公生南里5号。

木下裁判官称，他持有针对最后提到那名男子的逮捕令，
指控其在上海犯下三起谋杀案。

法国警方与裁判官商定，他们将拘留所有朝鲜人，
直至向法国领事馆提出申请将其引渡为止。

我从 Okijina 处获悉，日本领事馆当局已申请引渡
7名朝鲜人中的5人。当申请提交后，日方被告知
警方已释放所有朝鲜人。我相信日本总领事正就此事宜
与法国当局进行交涉。

此致，
敬礼，
R. Conduit.
副督察（D.S.）
首席侦探督察（D.C.I.）

May 17 192 2

REPORT ON Arrest and Release of Koreans in French Town

Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by

Sir,

Enquiries made by Detective Kim go to show that the arrest of seven Koreans in French Town on May 14 created quite a sensation among a section of Koreans in French Town. The Korean residents of that Concession did not however make any demonstration against the arrest, but it is reported that a few prominent Koreans interviewed an official of the French Consulate about the matter. The prisoners were held in custody from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. when they were released as the Japanese Authorities failed to produce any evidence against them.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Givens
D. I.

D. C. I.

May 18, 1922.

P. S. - From further inquiries made there is every reason to believe that the Korean who went to the French Consulate in connection with the above matter is Ahn Chang Ho (安昌浩), formerly Minister of Labour in the so-called "Korean Provisional Government". Ahn was educated in America. He went to French Consulate alone.

D. I. Givens
D. I.

I. REG 4550
日期：1922年5月24日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
中央巡捕房。
1922年5月17日

关于在法租界逮捕及释放朝鲜人的报告

由 D. I. Givens 撰写。呈报人

先生，

经侦探 Kim 调查表明，5月14日在法租界逮捕七名朝鲜人一事，
在法租界部分朝鲜人中引起了相当大的轰动。然而，该租界内的
朝鲜居民并未就此次逮捕举行任何示威活动，但据报有几名
朝鲜知名人士就此事会见了法国领事馆的一名官员。囚犯从
上午7时被拘留至下午4时，随后被释放，因为日本当局
未能提出任何针对他们的证据。

此致，
敬礼，
D. I. Givens
侦探督察（D. I.）

首席侦探督察（D. C. I.）

1922年5月18日。

附言——经进一步调查，有充分理由相信，就上述事宜
前往法国领事馆的那名朝鲜人是安昌浩（Ahn Chang Ho），
他曾任所谓“大韩民国临时政府”的劳工部长。安氏曾
在美国受教育。他是独自前往法国领事馆的。

D. I. Givens
侦探督察（D. I.）
